## Key Offerings & Details

### 1. Moqa Ka Plots & Verified CDA/RDA Land
- Locations: TopCity-1 (Block A, B, C, D), PECHS Islamabad (Block K, M), Faisal Town Phase 2, B-17 Multi Gardens.
- Status: 100% cash possession plots on ground, direct transfer, no pending litigation or litigation risk.
- Typical price ranges: 5 Marla (PKR 35 Lac - 75 Lac), 10 Marla (PKR 75 Lac - 1.50 Crore), 1 Kanal (PKR 1.40 Crore - 3.20 Crore).

### 2. PHA Executive Flats (Sector I-12 & Sector I-16)
- Ready possession federal apartments built by Pakistan Housing Authority (PHA).
- Specifications: 2-Bed (1,150 sq ft) and 3-Bed (1,450 sq ft) executive layouts.
- Amenities: Dual passenger and cargo elevators, dedicated parking, standby generator, gated 24/7 security.
- Pricing: PKR 75 Lac to PKR 1.10 Crore.

### 3. Harsukh Residencies (Nathia Gali / Kuza Gali)
- Hillside luxury suites with panoramic forest and valley views.
- Configurations: Executive Studio, 1-Bedroom, and 2-Bedroom furnished vacation apartments.
- Payment Terms: 15% booking deposit, remainder spread across 3-year easy quarterly or monthly installments.
- Investment Return: 20%+ projected annual rental yield via managed holiday-home leasing.

### 4. Turnkey Construction & Grey Structure
- Standards: A+ executive construction utilizing Grade-60 steel, OPC cement, solid brickwork, and earthquake-resistant structural designs.
- Rates: Grey structure rates start at PKR 2,400 - 2,800/sq ft. Complete turnkey finishing starts at PKR 4,500 - 6,500/sq ft.
- Supervision: In-house PEC-licensed civil and structural engineers with milestone-based inspection reports.

### 5. Tier-1 On-Grid Solar Net Metering
- System sizes: 5kW, 10kW, 15kW, 20kW, 30kW, and 50kW commercial setups.
- Equipment: Tier-1 Bloomberg-listed bifacial N-type monocrystalline solar panels with high-efficiency on-grid string inverters (Huawei, Sungrow, Growatt).
- Approvals: Complete turnkey end-to-end processing with IESCO (Islamabad Electric Supply Company) for bi-directional green net meters.
- Payback: 2.5 to 3.5 years average return on investment, eliminating residential and commercial electricity tariffs.
